cleansingStrength.rationale: Low by C6: no prominent strong anionic; the earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is the mild anionic Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate @2 with a prominent amphoteric co-surfactant (Cocamidopropyl Hydroxysultaine @5). Counter-signal lowering confidence: the chassis is anionic-dominated (three mild anionics @2, @3, @6, plus taurate @33) and the only amphoteric comes fourth, after the alkanolamide @4, so realistic concentration unknowns could make the net cleansing moderate. Convention value kept (C1-C6 preamble).

conditioningLevel.rationale: High by C2: prominent silicones (Amodimethicone @30, Silicone Quaternium-18 @31; prominent because before Fragrance @45) plus a cationic polymer (Polyquaternium-10 @37) plus a pearlizing route (Glycol Distearate @7) plus a closed-list humectant route (Glycerin @8, Panthenol @11); further routes: Cetrimonium Chloride @29, Quaternium-95 @32, material payload lipids @19/@20/@24/@25, Hydrolyzed Milk Protein @26. Counter-signal: every conditioning route sits after trace vitamins (Biotin @13), so each is plausibly at a low level; realistic unknowns could make the rinse-off care bounded (moderate).

weightPotential.depositionLoad: moderate - six deposition families converge (two silicones incl. amodimethicone, polyquaternium-10, two quats, four material lipids, protein), but each is listed after trace-level vitamins, so the absolute dose of each route is plausibly small
weightPotential.persistence: high - amodimethicone and a quaternized silicone with cationic polymer/quats are substantive, plausibly persistent routes; waxy shea butter and jojoba esters add persistence
weightPotential.resetCapacity: weak - C6 low mild-anionic/amphoteric chassis, no strong anionic
weightPotential.counterevidence: All deposition routes sit after Biotin @13 and other trace vitamins (likely sub-1 % zone); silicones appear with their emulsion carriers (Trideceth-6/-12, Cetrimonium Chloride), suggesting small silicone dose; ordinary rinse-off context.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: High: W-RICH holds (material payload lipids @19/@20/@24/@25 converge with silicone and cationic deposition) and reset is limited (resetCapacity weak), which is the rich route of the high anchor; the convergence route also holds (silicone + cationic polymer + cationic conditioner + material lipid + protein).
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate: the anchor's rich route (W-RICH with weak reset) and the convergence route both hold; a moderate call would rest only on the unknown absolute dose of late routes, which is the realistic unknown that sets confidence at moderate rather than a reason for the lighter band (P0).
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Position of all deposition routes after trace-level actives; absolute doses unknown, so realistic unknowns could move the band one step to moderate.
